common.studio_p1: Sutra — the Sanskrit word for thread: the single line that holds a story together. Haus — the studio that weaves it. The name is a promise of coherence: your website, your imagery and your film, made by the same hands, in the same language.
common.studio_p2: Sutra Haus is the studio of Sutrahaus LLP, Bengaluru — owner-led and deliberately small. The person you write to is the person who designs, builds and ships the work: no account managers, no hand-offs, no templates. Our first works — a landmark hotel's complete digital rebuild and a consumer brand built from zero — are both live, and both proof of the same conviction: premium is the feeling three seconds after the page loads.

hotels.title: Hotel Website Design & Media — Sutra Haus
hotels.desc: Sutra Haus takes a hotel's entire digital surface off the owner's plate: website rebuild with direct booking, art-directed imagery and film — one studio, one monthly rhythm, priced for your market.
hotels.h1: You have a hotel to run. The internet shouldn't be a second job.
hotels.lede: Guests decide in seconds — on a website from another era, a feed that trails off, and OTA listings that charge you for your own guests. We take that entire surface off your plate: the website, the imagery, the film, and the bookings they bring.
hotels.t1_p: Before anyone calls reception, they've seen your website. If it feels dated, so does the property — whatever the lobby looks like.
hotels.t2_p: Commissions of 15–25% quietly outspend any marketing budget. A booking-first website turns your cheapest channel — direct — into your biggest one.
hotels.t3_p: Travellers read Instagram like a second website. Silence — or clip-art posters — reads as a property in decline.
hotels.relief_p: You approve; we do the rest. One studio instead of four hires, one invoice instead of five vendors.
hotels.r1_p: Design, build, hosting, SSL, updates, uptime. You own the domain and every asset — always.
hotels.r2_p: Your existing booking engine, integrated — with live proof that booking direct beats the OTA price.
hotels.r3_p: A monthly rhythm of original, art-directed creatives — seasons, suites, food, celebrations — in a visual language invented for your property alone.
hotels.r4_p: Vertical films with hooks built from audience research, plus shot lists your own team can carry on a phone.
hotels.r5_p: Structured data and machine-readable brand facts — found on Google today, recommended by AI concierges tomorrow.
hotels.r6_p: What went live, what it did, what's next. One page, no jargon.
hotels.case_p1: A sixty-key property with five banquet halls and a rooftop restaurant, living on a dated template. We rebuilt the entire digital presence — two websites, a direct-booking flow, and 125+ original creatives in a visual language invented for the house.
hotels.case_p2: The new site surfaces live direct rates against OTA prices — currently about thirty percent lower — and holds Google Lighthouse mobile scores in the nineties.

commerce.title: E-commerce & Brand Design — Sutra Haus
commerce.desc: Sutra Haus builds consumer brands end to end: e-commerce stores, product and lifestyle imagery, packaging direction and content — proven on a brand we built from zero, priced for your market.
commerce.h1: You build the product. We build everything between it and the customer.
commerce.lede: A store that converts, imagery with one voice, and content that compounds. We've proven the whole chain on our own brand — name to store to photograph to sale — and we run it for yours.
commerce.t1_p: A visitor decides almost instantly whether a brand feels real. Type, imagery and speed do that work before a single word is read.
commerce.t2_p: A theme makes you look like everyone who bought the theme. Distinctiveness isn't decoration — it's the reason people remember to come back.
commerce.t3_p: Paid traffic rents attention; a consistent visual voice owns it. The brands that win publish like studios.
commerce.relief_p: You approve; we do the rest. One studio for the store, the imagery, the words and the film.
commerce.r1_p: Shopify and beyond — merchandising, product pages and checkout flows designed to convert quietly.
commerce.r2_p: Packaging heroes, flat-lays and real-life scenes — one locked visual grammar that makes a young brand feel established.
commerce.r3_p: Identity, colour systems and packaging visuals with one voice across every touchpoint.
commerce.r4_p: Product pages written like stories, editorial that earns search traffic, and social copy in the brand's own cadence.
commerce.r5_p: Vertical films for social and campaigns — hooks from research, not guesswork.
commerce.r6_p: Structured data, performance and machine-readable brand facts — found and recommended, by people and by machines.
commerce.case_p1: Our own venture, and the studio's fullest proof: name, identity, packaging system, a ten-product line, the e-commerce store, photography and every word of copy — one thread, one house.
commerce.case_p2: Signature colour per product, one locked layout grammar, one tone of voice — the discipline that makes a new brand feel established on day one.
